# The Blyx handbook

Blyx 0.2.3 · Released language and toolchain

Start with a complete fn main(). Run your program in the playground or use blyxc check FILE followed by blyxc run FILE. For a native executable, use blyxc build FILE with Rust and a host linker installed.

[Learn Blyx](https://www.blyx-lang.space/learn) · [Playground](https://www.blyx-lang.space/play) · [Executable subset](https://github.com/Rahulchaube1/blyxxxx/blob/blyx-main/docs/executable-subset.md) · [Full handbook](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/llms-full.txt)

The release supports synchronous functions, recursion, control flow and numeric vectors. Native projects can import Git-pinned Blyx packages and read files or command-line arguments. See the [ecosystem](https://www.blyx-lang.space/packages) for published libraries. GPU kernels, async tasks and a general tensor runtime are under development.

## First steps

- [Your first Blyx program](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/first-program) — Start in the browser, make a prediction, then edit and run your first line of Blyx.

- [Numbers and expressions](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/arithmetic) — Use a packing problem to learn whole numbers, decimals, operator order and integer division.

- [Text, comments and output](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/text-output) — Build a receipt one value at a time and learn how strings differ from variable names.

## Language essentials

- [Bindings, mutation and scope](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/bindings) — Trace a name through nested blocks and choose when a value should change.

- [Booleans and decisions](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/decisions) — Classify temperatures, then test exactly what happens at the boundaries.

- [Functions, parameters and results](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/functions) — Give a calculation a name, call it more than once, and use its return value in another expression.

- [While loops and the Euclidean algorithm](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/control-flow) — Trace changing state and explain why a loop finishes.

- [Break, continue and loop values](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/loop-exits) — Find the first matching integer and carry it out of a loop.

- [Recursion and the cost of a call](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/recursion) — Trace Fibonacci by hand, identify the base case, and decide when iteration is cheaper.

## Numerical programming

- [Vectors and reductions](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/vectors) — Represent several readings in one value and combine them into a weighted mean.

- [Scan a vector for its maximum](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/vector-scans) — Design a loop that finds the largest value even when every reading is negative.

- [Smooth a sequence with one running value](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/smoothing) — Turn a noisy signal into a sequence of estimates and trace how much history each estimate retains.

- [Fit a line and predict a value](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/numerical-models) — Fit a one-parameter model, inspect its assumptions, and predict the response at an unseen input.

- [Measure prediction error](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/model-error) — Evaluate a set of predictions, trace the residuals and interpret their mean squared error.

- [Classify using a score and a threshold](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/classification) — Combine two features, choose a category, and decide how ties are classified.

## Practical projects

- [Test a program at its boundaries](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/testing) — Design a small repeatable test suite that catches an off-by-one classification rule.

- [Capstone project — build a sensor report](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/sensor-report) — Build a complete report from a blank file, handle empty input, and verify a boundary condition.

- [Evaluate models with Blyx packages](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/ai-packages) — Compare the cost of two classifiers, check their probability forecasts, and score a ranked retrieval result. Run the comparison in CI or import the same Blyx functions into your application.

- [Train, calibrate and monitor a regression model](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/training-and-monitoring) — Fit a regression, attach intervals using held-out errors, and catch persistent underprediction in a later stream. Run each stage in native Blyx or the browser.

- [Train a neural network with BlyxTorch](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/blyxtorch) — Train a network in Blyx, fit a feature classifier on CPU or Vulkan GPU, and use a saved checkpoint from a local or hosted AI application.

## Framework projects

- [Swiftlet · Route a book catalog request](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/swiftlet) — Dispatch a method and request path against a table of literal and parameterized routes. Return a matched template and the methods a client can use.

- [Shrike · Merge two help-center searches](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/shrike) — Combine lexical and semantic search results by rank, then walk the merged list in a deterministic order.

- [Bunting · Publish a support-queue report](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/bunting) — Publish a distribution as a standalone HTML table with interval labels, counts and meters. Reuse the same bin definitions in reports and tests.

- [Wren · Test an invoice and packing calculation](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/wren) — Run named checks and skips, compare floating-point measurements, and report a TAP 13 stream and a process exit status for CI.

- [Weaver · Render a file chooser as SVG](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/weaver) — Lay out equal-width tiles on small or large viewports, distribute leftover pixels and map pointer coordinates back to an item.

- [Dipper · Import a two-column notes file](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/dipper) — Parse quoted CSV records, preserve embedded line breaks, and validate a row width before consuming a file.

- [Kestrel · Replay a bouncing ball across a stalled frame](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/kestrel) — Run a bounded number of simulation ticks per rendered frame, carry fractional frame time and interpolate a moving object between updates.

- [Heron · Audit a sensor heartbeat trace](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/heron) — Track one sensor feed’s accepted messages, duplicate sequence numbers, out-of-order arrivals and missed deadlines.

## Workflow recipes

- [Oriole · Decide when a reviewed revision can go live](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/oriole) — Decide whether a scheduled revision can go live after independent review.

- [Avocet · Reorder stock after reservations](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/avocet) — Plan replenishment after existing reservations and supplier lot sizes.

- [Ibis · Reconcile split invoice payments](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/ibis) — Reconcile an invoice with split payments in integer minor units.

- [Pipit · Resume a batch after a failed command](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/pipit) — Plan the next CLI batch from child exit codes and a failure allowance.

- [Nuthatch · Keep terminal help visible after a resize](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/nuthatch) — Wrap a message and preserve a valid scroll position after resizing a terminal.

- [Turnstone · Restart an interrupted chunked file job](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/turnstone) — Resume a chunked file job from acknowledged checkpoints.

- [Osprey · Score detections at the edge of a camera frame](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/osprey) — Score a detection against a reference after clipping both to the camera frame.

- [Warbler · Distinguish a clipped transient from a sustained overload](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/warbler) — Flag sustained clipping while reporting the energy of an audio frame.

- [Linnet · Bridge short pauses in a speech-activity trace](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/linnet) — Summarize speech-activity intervals from a precomputed frame-level envelope.

- [Curlew · Cover a survey that crosses a grid origin](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/curlew) — Plan grid tiles covering every observation in a projected point survey.

- [Egret · Compare abundance and diversity in a field survey](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/egret) — Summarize richness, singletons and dominance in an ecological field survey.

- [Tanager · Audit a directed graph export](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/tanager) — Audit a directed edge list before interpreting a vertex's degree.

- [Merganser · Measure a loss that recovered before the final observation](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/merganser) — Report drawdown depth and time below the running peak for a historical series.

- [Pintail · Measure turnover between two weight snapshots](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/pintail) — Compare long-only portfolio snapshots under a one-way turnover budget.

- [Siskin · Find a funding gap inside an otherwise positive cash schedule](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/siskin) — Inspect a cash-flow schedule for shortfalls that disappear by the closing date.

- [Sandpiper · Schedule redelivery after a lease expires](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/sandpiper) — Schedule a deterministic redelivery after both lease expiry and retry backoff.

- [Petrel · Decide whether a queued request can afford to wait](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/petrel) — Admit an immediate charge or report the wait a request can afford.

- [Fulmar · Commit offsets without skipping unfinished deliveries](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/fulmar) — Choose a contiguous commit offset from an out-of-order delivery trace.

- [Waxwing · Budget an expanded GraphQL field plan](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/waxwing) — Check the depth and weighted resolver cost of an expanded GraphQL field plan.

- [Martin · Fit a retry into an RPC deadline](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/martin) — Decide whether another RPC attempt fits the remaining end-to-end deadline.

- [Kinglet · Serve a byte range at end of file](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/kinglet) — Plan a full or single-range HTTP response against a known representation size.

- [Barnowl · Find clock reversals and gaps in an audit export](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/barnowl) — Inspect a supplied audit export for sequence gaps, replays and clock reversals.

- [Harrier · Apply freshness policy to a verified session](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/harrier) — Apply time and assurance policy to a session after upstream identity verification.

- [Plover · Gate an alert on short and long error windows](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/plover) — Gate alerts on error-budget burn in both a short and a long window.

- [Jacana · Compare a crude rate with a standardized rate](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/jacana) — Compare a crude event rate with a directly standardized rate.

- [Redstart · Update a binary-event probability after observations](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/redstart) — Update a binary-event model and report uncertainty in its probability.

- [Quail · Compare a real-qubit circuit with observed shots](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/quail) — Simulate a short real-amplitude single-qubit circuit and compare shot counts.

- [Skimmer · Read parity alongside two-bit marginals](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/skimmer) — Compare parity and marginal balance in two-bit shot data.

- [Magpie · Integrate unevenly spaced observations](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/magpie) — Integrate an increasing sample grid and flag under-sampled sections.

- [Flamingo · Choose chart ticks for an observed range](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/flamingo) — Produce chart-ready axis limits and labeled tick spacing from raw data.

- [Bittern · Decide whether the next database migration can run](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/bittern) — Plan the next migration only after history, fingerprints and dirty state agree.

- [Grebe · Resume a keyset page from its last emitted key](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/grebe) — Build a repeatable keyset page and return the exact next cursor.

- [Dunlin · Audit a parent and child table before import](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/dunlin) — Audit a table export for duplicate parents and orphaned child rows.

- [Sanderling · Carry cache age across a local storage interval](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/sanderling) — Choose a cache serving mode from stored age, local elapsed time and grace policy.

- [Cormorant · Separate packet jitter from a fixed clock offset](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/cormorant) — Separate variation in packet delivery from a constant difference between clocks.

- [Bulbul · Validate required and extra object fields](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/bulbul) — Check required and extra fields in an already parsed object.

- [Fantail · Find which settings layer supplied an invalid override](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/fantail) — Resolve a layered setting and report where an invalid override came from.

- [Swallow · Verify a record table before interpreting a byte offset](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/swallow) — Validate an exported payload's declared spans and checksum, then locate a byte.

- [Lapwing · Paginate a report with indivisible paragraphs](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/lapwing) — Preflight fixed-line document pagination with indivisible paragraphs.

- [Hoopoe · Check a thumbnail buffer before allocation](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/hoopoe) — Plan a thumbnail and check the decoded pixel buffer against a byte budget.

- [Spoonbill · Detect overlapping captions in a rational time base](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/spoonbill) — Preflight caption cue timings against an explicit overlap policy.

- [Raven · Budget a log buffer during an error burst](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/raven) — Budget a bounded log buffer while preserving higher-severity events first.

- [Robin · Convert a civil date into comparable day numbers](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/robin) — Convert a validated civil date into an ordinal, weekday and comparable day number.

- [Starling · Size a resource pool from overlapping bookings](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/starling) — Estimate resource capacity and actual occupied time from a booking schedule.

- [Blackbird · Resolve both occurrences of an ambiguous wall time](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/blackbird) — Resolve a wall-clock timestamp at a known gap or fold without guessing its offset.

- [Towhee · Locate the first actionable source-style violation](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/towhee) — Combine indentation and line-width diagnostics for a measured source file.

- [Bowerbird · Check a proposed dependency upgrade numerically](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/bowerbird) — Decide whether a proposed numeric-core dependency upgrade fits a declared version range.

- [Albatross · Estimate a build's critical-path lower bound](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/albatross) — Estimate a build forest's scheduling lower bound from dependencies and worker capacity.

- [Chaffinch · Reconcile two sorted snapshots with repeated keys](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/chaffinch) — Reconcile sorted collection snapshots without materializing their union.

- [Pelican · Compare merged reads with aligned per-request reads](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/pelican) — Compare per-request aligned I/O with coalesced unaligned reads for a sorted trace.

- [Nightingale · Bound a percentile from histogram counts](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/nightingale) — Bound a percentile from histogram counts without inventing a within-bin value.

## Local toolchain

- [Install a library and inspect its release](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/nest-release-files) — Validate a UTF-8 character across two reads, decode a framed message, and verify a single file from its published Blyx release.

- [Install and verify Blyx](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/installation) — Choose a binary or package manager, locate the executable, and verify the exact compiler version.

- [Create a project on disk](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/projects) — Move a program from the browser into a project, check the file and run it from a terminal.

- [Develop in VS Code](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/editor) — Run an unsaved editor buffer, read a parser diagnostic and move the same program to the CLI.

- [Debug and recover from errors](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/diagnostics) — Locate a syntax error, diagnose a runtime failure, and guard an operation using short-circuit evaluation.

- [Build a native executable](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/native-builds) — Build an x86-64 program with Blyx Direct, reproduce the self-hosted compiler, or use the 0.2.3 toolchain for numerical workloads.

## Language reference

- [Syntax, types and operators](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/language-reference) — Look up the executable forms, operator order and value types used in Blyx 0.2.3.

- [Built-in functions and output](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/builtin-reference) — Look up every vector built-in and both output macros, including their inputs, results and boundary cases.

- [Command-line reference](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/cli-reference) — Look up CLI forms, output files, execution budgets and exit codes.

- [What Blyx 0.2.3 can run](https://doc.blyx-lang.space/guide/compatibility) — Choose an execution mode and identify features that are still being developed.
